FCI plays a crucial role in implementing NFSA by ensuring availability of subsidized grains to nearly two-thirds of India's population.

items: Target Population Coverage: Nearly two-thirds (66.6%) of India's total population.
Role of FCI: Key agency responsible for executing the NFSA grain distribution.
Enactment Year: National Food Security Act was passed in 2013.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Food Corporation of India (FCI) serves as the primary implementation agency for the NFSA.
NFSA guarantees subsidized food grains to almost two-thirds of the Indian population.
The Act was enacted in 2013 to provide legal rights to subsidized food security.
